summary: Transfer petition under CPC §25; irretrievable breakdown of marriage as ground for divorce under Art.142(1) Constitution; allegations of mental cruelty, monetary & non-monetary demands; multiple criminal complaints by wife including FIRs under IPC §§354, 376, 498A; respondent arrested on LOC; maintenance/quantum proceedings transferred to Pune Family Court; marriage irretrievably broken; wife's transfer plea granted for limited purpose of alimony determination.
final_judgment: Transfer petition granted limited to Pune Family Court for alimony/quantum determination; irretrievable breakdown recognized; divorce under Art.142 permitted pending final terms.
